Users set the core goal they want to achieve with the central keyword, define detailed goals for the core goal, and set specific action guidelines or mindsets for each detailed goal. What sets this app apart from other mandalart apps is that you can create a checklist based on it, rather than just making a mandalart, and record it every day.

[ **Purchasing Policy** ]

This application does not use a subscription policy. It can be used with a single purchase, and services are not differentiated through in-app purchases after that. Updates apply equally to everyone.

This app starts by writing a mandalart.

A mandalart consists of 9 squares each horizontally and vertically. It consists of a total of 81 squares.

Each rectangle is filled with a goal and its related contents.

The core goal is in the center, and the detailed goals that make up the core goal are placed around the core goal.

And the periphery is the place for the detailed goal, and the detailed goal goes in the middle, and the Specific action guidelines and attitudes are included.

When using a mandalart for the purpose of achieving a goal, it is common to use one mandalart. So there is only one mandalart at a time.
